jobs.description: IntroductionATworld, operated by Simplify Places GmbH, is redefining the way we work and connect.We offer a flexible, connected, and ownable 'fourth space' - a dynamic ecosystem where individuals and companies can access resources, services, and communities anytime, anywhere.Supported today by hotels and offices owned by Aroundtown, ATworld is rapidly expanding across Europe and partnering with external locations such as hotels, cafés, and coworking spaces. We are committed to proving that doing good and doing well can go hand in hand.Backed by Aroundtown - one of Europe’s leading real estate companies - ATworld has the resources and scale to pioneer the future of work.Your responsibilitiesOnboarding and listings- Take partners from signed contract to live: create listings, hold the onboarding call with an app demo, set the location live.- Keep listings accurate, maintaining consistency and quality across the app.- Work with the team lead together to improve existing processes, to then prepare the operations for growthAccount management- Be our partners’ point of contact and build relationships ensuring their success with ATworld.- Consult them on the listing, offering, and potential initiatives to increase bookings, visibility, and/or payout.- Maintain a regular contact strategy and review booking as well as feedback reports.- Review the partner reconciliation report to check the payouts.Partner support- Handle partner requests on bookings, content, and listing changes.- Keep response times visible and improve them where you can.- Turn repeat questions into a clear SOP or a better listing flow.Systems, quality, and reporting- Work in HubSpot every day: pipeline, tasks, tickets, and activity on the account.- Review our bookings and feedback report, spot patterns and opportunities that will improve our members’ experience on site. Who we are looking for- 2–3 years in account management, partner or customer success, hospitality operations, coworking, or a similar marketplace / supply role.- You're an excellent communicator, both in writing and verbally. You can explain complex topics in a simple, clear, and friendly manner. You are comfortable speaking on the phone and in person with out partners.- Highly organized & proactive: You can juggle multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment without losing sight of the details. You don't wait to be told what to do; you actively look for ways to help.- You’re tech-savvy and comfortable using various software and back-office systems for managing data and content. - You're detail-oriented and thorough in your work, ensuring consistent quality in the projects you are working on.- You are curious about how to make a repeatable process better.- Berlin-Based: You are located in Berlin and are excited about a hybrid role that combines remote work with in-person collaboration.- Comfortable working with a CRM, HubSpot is a plus.- Fluent in German and English.- A Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field is a plus.What we offer- Working from all the different ATworld locations.- Being part of a fun, dynamic, and international team.- Real impact. You can shape the processes, production, and decisions that are made.- Flat hierarchy, so you will be working very closely with the leadership of the team.Contact informationIf you are interested, we are looking forward to your application!For any questions, feel free to reach out to Esther Köhne at esther.koehne@thisisatworld.com.Looking forward to meeting you!

ABOUT THE ROLEAktrion Germany is looking for a driven Project Supervisor to join our team in Ragow. In this role, you will be responsible for excellent project performance and serve as the enabler to deliver automotive quality inspection, containment, rework, and customer support activities.KEY RESPONSIBILITIES- Ensure compliance with customer site instructions, work instructions, HSE, and 5S requirements.- Set up and enable inspection, sorting, containment, and rework activities.- Set up and maintain accurate documentation and traceability.- Use Aktrion digital reporting tools and customer systems to monitor KPIs and prepare reports.- Coordinate customer's technical and commercial targets and requirements.- Coordinate projects, personnel, and daily operations.- Communicate with customer representatives, monitor KPIs, and prepare reports.- Coach and develop team members on site.YOUR PROFILE- Languages: Very good English mandatory; German and/or Polish are an advantage.- Automotive quality knowledge and experience.- Attention to detail and ability to work under pressure.- Experience managing kick-offs, meetings, deadlines, and customer feedback.- Digital literacy: MS Office (Excel, Teams, Outlook), computer literacy, customer portals, basic statistical analysis.- Willingness to work in shifts.PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS- ISO 9001, 3S/5S, and Lean awareness.- Valid driving license.- First Aid certificate, Forklift license (preferred), High Voltage Level 1–3 (depending on project).WHAT WE OFFER- Competitive salary.- 28 days of paid vacation per year.- Company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge).- Great working atmosphere, mutual support, and team spirit.- Company laptop and mobile phone.- Ongoing training and career development.- Opportunity to join a growing international automotive business.APPLICATION- Location: Ragow, Germany- Send your application to: jobs.de@aktrion.comErgänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: Projektmanagement

DAS BIETEN WIR DIR• Attraktives Gehalt• Normale und Flexible Arbeitszeiten: kein Schichtbetrieb, keine Frühschicht, keine Abendarbeit, kein Wochenende• 30 Tage Urlaub• Festanstellung• Keine Reisetätigkeit• Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in unserem Team• Moderne, saubere Werkstatt mit ergonomischen Arbeitsplätzen• EGYM Wellpass• Gratis Kaffee und Müslibar im Büro• Parkplatz, gute Verkehrsanbindung, barrierefreies Arbeitsumfeld• Mitarbeiter-Events und InternetnutzungWir bauen in München autonome mobile Roboter, die verändern, wie Material bewegt wird. Unser Doppel-Runner-System ist der erste und einzige autonome mobile Roboter, der durch Ladungsträger wie Europaletten hindurchfahren kann. Wir fahren gerade die Produktion hoch, und dafür suchen wir dich.DEINE AUFGABEN• Montage: Du baust unsere Roboter selbstständig zusammen, nach geltenden Normen, technischen Zeichnungen, Stücklisten und Arbeitsplänen.• Antrieb und Elektronik: Du baust Motoren, Antriebe, Sensoren und Elektronik ein.• Fehlersuche: Wenn etwas nicht läuft, findest du den Fehler und behebst ihn direkt in der Montage.• Qualität: Du führst Qualitätsprüfungen durch und sicherst so unsere Qualitätsstandards.• Rückmeldung: Probleme, die dir auffallen, meldest du proaktiv zurück.DAS BRINGST DU MIT• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Mechatroniker:in (m/w/d)• Mindestens 4 Jahre Berufserfahrung• Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in mechanischer und elektrischer Montage, z. B. Verschrauben mit Drehmoment, Crimpen, Löten und ESD-gerechtes Arbeiten• Mindestens 2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Fehlersuche an mechatronischen Baugruppen, z. B. an Mechanik oder Sensoren• Du kannst Schaltpläne lesen und mit dem Multimeter messen, gern auch mit dem Oszilloskop.• Deutsch mindestens auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau• Arbeit vor Ort in MünchenÜber unsFilics’ mission is to reinvent intralogistics by creating autonomous mobile robots that fundamentally change how material moves. Our double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR able to drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets, breaking forklift logic and setting a new standard for efficiency. We are a small, focused team committed to solving hard problems with engineering excellence. All team members are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All team members are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

jobs.employer_name: Josera Erbacher Service GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: For over 80 years, at ERBACHER the food family we have been developing innovative solutions in animal nutrition for livestock and pets, as well as producing high-quality food, made possible by the dedication of our teams in Germany, Ukraine, Tanzania, and Poland.Step by step, we turn ideas into innovations that have a real impact on everyday life, and every project is based on collaboration, mutual respect, and commitment. At ERBACHER the food family, we believe in a good tomorrow… and we create it.We are looking for people who want to create a good tomorrow together with us.Responsibilities- Lead and support the P&C Business Partners team through regular feedback and coaching.- Build trusted relationships with leaders, advise them on key people matters and connect them with P&C teams.- Help leaders turn business goals into clear people and team actions.- Manage conflicts and sensitive situations fairly and discreetly, involving Legal or other experts, when required.- Promote a culture based on trust, accountability and open communication.- Ensure effective management of employee and labour-related matters and ongoing process improvement.Requirements:- 3+ years’ HR/P&C Business Partner experience.- Degree in HR, business, law, psychology or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.- Good understanding of workforce planning, including skills, capacity, succession and hiring needs.- Solid knowledge of German employment law, HR processes and data protection.- Experience in collaboration with German works council.- Initial people-leadership or team-coordination experience.- Experience in cross-teams collaboration, including working with Talent Acquisition, People Operations, Development & Engagement, Legal and Corporate Communication teams.- Strong communication, coaching, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills.- C1/C2-level English and willingness to work from the office at least 3 days per week.What You Can ExpectPeople are at the heart of everything we do. We encourage individual talents and create an environment where everyone can contribute, bring ideas to life and work effectively as part of a team.What exactly can you expect from us?- Innovative, creative, and sometimes unconventional ways of thinking and working.- A wide range of development and training opportunities, as well as various language courses.- Flexible working arrangements and remote working.- A varied and challenging role with room to shape things, and the opportunity to have a say and put ideas into practice.- Flexible working hours – additional vacation days - Christmas and vacation bonuses.- Occupational pension scheme and accident insurance - bonus.- Sports, mobility, and health benefits.- Free muesli, fruit, and vegetables.- Healthy, subsidized lunches.- We support e-mobility with charging stations at our headquarters and the option to lease an electric vehicle.- Work - and enjoy team events together - in an international environment with colleagues from Poland, Germany, Tanzania, and Ukraine.- Ongoing professional and personal development through tailored training and development programs.- An inspiring, supportive atmosphere and modern working conditions, with tools and technologies that support your development and help you work more efficiently.*What matters is that we’re a good fit. Your background and gender are irrelevant.Does this sound like you? We look forward to receiving your detailed application, including your earliest possible start date and salary expectations. Please note that we can only consider applications submitted through the application form on our careers page.Contact detailsRecruiting TeamTel.: 09371 940-2220Email: jobs@food.family (jobs@food.family)  (for questions only)Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Workflow-Management-Systeme, OrganisationsentwicklungErweiterte Kenntnisse: Personalentwicklung, Talentmanagement, Personalplanung, Arbeitsrecht, Datenschutz

As we scale from one site in Germany to two with our new facility in Texas, quality can't be an afterthought or a paper exercise. We're looking for a Quality Manager who builds a pragmatic, ISO 9001-compliant Quality Management System from the ground up for our Texas site, keeps our German QMS sharp, and creates a quality culture that engineers, operators, and management actually live — not one that gathers dust in a document folder.THE WHAT- Own ISO 9001 at both sites: Maintain certification in Germany and establish it in Texas, preparing all audits — internal, certification, and customer — together with the teams so they're passed without major findings. Blackwave Code: High Performance- Build processes people actually use: Define and implement essential quality processes that are pragmatic and scalable enough for development, manufacturing, and management to apply confidently in daily work. Blackwave Code: Togetherness- Make performance visible: Give leadership clear, up-to-date visibility into company performance through meaningful KPIs and management reviews that drive decisions rather than just report numbers. Blackwave Code: Candor- Own risk end-to-end: Establish and actively maintain a company-wide risk management system covering organizational, process, and product risks — with clear ownership and follow-up on mitigations. Blackwave Code: Accountability- Digitize quality: Establish a digital QMS platform as the mandatory system of record, with quality documentation and workflows fully migrated and adopted across the organization. Blackwave Code: PlayfulnessYOUR PROFILE- 3–5+ years of experience in quality management within a manufacturing environment — you've stood on a shop floor, not just in an office- Degree in a technical field (e.g. aerospace or mechanical engineering) plus relevant further training in quality management- Hands-on ISO 9001 experience: you've managed audit cycles and can walk us through a process you set up yourself, end to end- Pragmatic quality mindset: you build processes for usage, not just for compliance — standards are an enabler, not bureaucracy- Builder mentality: you create structures from scratch rather than maintaining what's already there, and you see a bit of chaos as an opportunity- Strong ownership and communication at all levels — from C-level to operator- Fluent English is a must; German is a plusWHAT WE OFFER- Freedom to Create: Extensive decision-making freedom and short decision paths – we trust your expertise to lead your team.- Fresh Fuel Every Day: Shared lunch breaks with freshly prepared, varied meals to keep the team energized.- Coffee Culture @ Blackwave: Enjoy premium coffee from our portafilter machine or join one of our barista courses.- Choose Your Perk: Select from a Deutschland-Ticket, EGYM Wellpass, or a Give Card.- Gear up for Take-off: Receive premium Blackwave team apparel during your on boarding.- Grow in Aerospace: Expand your professional horizons in a high-growth company at the forefront of space technology.- Rooftop Relaxation: End your day on our spacious rooftop terrace with a panoramic view of the Alps.Please refer to reference number YF-51680 for your application.Apply for this job
